manifest.title: Technical candle pulse integration; no financial hypothesis
manifest.market_hypothesis: None: artificial candle-body pulse to exercise the software integration, not an alpha claim.
manifest.rationale: Distinct from engulfing/breakout: close-versus-open pulse with no breakout level, plus a doji no-operation control.

data_requirements.horizon: Six generated days starting2000-01-10 plus20 warmup hours; never market history.
data_requirements.gap_policy: UTC DatetimeIndex, sorted/unique. Entry requires previous index exactly1h earlier. Never access candles.timestamp or create a timestamp column.
dataset_refs: Generated deterministically by circuit_fixture.py after verified implementation

signal_spec.long_entry: At close T, row position>=20: close[T]>open[T] AND close[T-1]<=open[T-1] AND index[T]-index[T-1]==1h. All first20 rows false; doji is not bullish.
signal_spec.long_exit: At close T, row position>=20: close[T]<open[T]. First20 rows false; doji false.
signal_spec.feature_definitions: Implement integration_candle_pulse_v1 version1.0.0, research, Parameters empty StrictModel rejecting unknown fields. BaseStrategy, lab_timeframes=(1h,), lab_modes=(LONG_ONLY,), lab_execution=ohlcv; required_warmup returns20. prepare_features copies OHLCV indexed by UTC DatetimeIndex and retains alignment. Compute bullish/nonbullish(previous shifted1), bearish and contiguous index differences. Return Python bools for each row; both short methods always false. No timestamp column, no future data or input mutation. Write meaningful native-index/warmup/gap/long/short/prefix tests. Keep strategy YAML enabled:false. No experiment/history changes. Set created_at to explicit timezone-aware UTC, e.g.2026-11-04T00:00:00Z (not a bare date).

parameter_space.limit_rationale: Reglas congeladas sin parametros ajustables; cero barridos.

execution_assumptions.runner_protocol: StudyBackend v1 / lab_experiment_v1; spot LONG_ONLY, six bounded synthetic cases. Signals at close, fills next open; no changes to engine.
execution_assumptions.stop: Existing RiskConfig ATR14 Wilder x2; strategy does not implement fills or protective execution.
execution_assumptions.target: Existing2R, no trailing/time stop; do not tune to improve results.
execution_assumptions.sizing: Existing risk1pct, maximum position25pct/exposure100pct. Operational YAML disabled; enable only the identified execution copy.
execution_assumptions.intrabar_policy: Contrato existente stop-first y gaps adversos; sin cambios de ejecucion.

evaluation_plan.holdout_risk: Entirely artificial data; no independent financial holdout is claimed or consumed.
evaluation_plan.primary_metric: Complete pipeline and nonzero closed trades for active BTC case in each period; zero ETH trades. No return/PF threshold.
evaluation_plan.falsification: Block if native compatibility, causal rule tests, evidence identity, or active/inactive technical coverage fails.
evaluation_plan.robustness_plan: No economic or parameter optimization; only deterministic software fixtures.

novelty.prior_work: New pulse fixture, not engulfing or a budget-reset clone. No claim of economic novelty.

limitations: Technical integration only; no economic inference, demo or live approval.
A doji dataset deliberately yields no trades; pulse cases need entries/exits, not profitability.

implementation.review_note: Frozen technical integration card prepared under user4.6 scope; review before operator launch. No trading activation.
